scope: Existing native room operation fingerprint characterization; no production or DI changes
observations: Same original operation and same proof replays the recorded receipt.
The same operation with a new actual client build returns operation_payload_mismatch without writes.
After native session version advances, current room metadata remains readable; the old operation with the new version conflicts.
The stale original native proof cannot regain authority; original request/native version/client/revision remain unchanged.
limits: This is current behavior, not an implemented original receipt recovery route.
No provider I/O, device installation, schema change or Group rollout.
A missing receipt cannot by itself fence a late original request.
